narrative.northStar: The Imperial PDR Dossier & Telemetry Console
narrative.overview:
This visual system presents a 120-km orbital battle station as a deadpan, forensic systems-engineering artifact—where aerospace blueprint discipline and MIL-STD Preliminary/Critical Design Review documentation meet a live dark-terminal telemetry console. Every screen and page treats impossible orders of magnitude (10¹⁸ kg, 10²⁷ W, 10³² J) with clinical composure: monospace scientific notation, explicit section-code stamps (§0 through §12, Appx A–H), and color-coded traceability badges that separate analytical physics (DR-NN Class A) from irreducible physics concessions (HW-1..10 Class C).

The aesthetic is forensic, dense, and instrument-grade. Surfaces are constructed from stepped dark slate planes bounded by razor-sharp 1px structural hairlines, square 0px corners, and 6px × 6px hardware status pips. The system strictly rejects rounded consumer SaaS cards, soft ambient drop shadows, playful sci-fi fan-art ornament, and decorative neon cyberpunk gradients. When a surface illuminates—whether an amber timeline scrubber or a green tributary laser convergence—that light represents an explicit physical state or active measurement, never decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Dual-Authority Continuity: Shared token vocabulary across the interactive web console (proj-code/src/theme.ts), the 74-page Typst specification (typeset/template.typ), and the high-contrast A4 print export (proj-code/src/styles/print.css).

Semantic Traceability Color-Coding: Every accent hue maps to a specific verification or physical role—Amber for baseline command and inspection, Cyan for analysis and CDR deltas, Crimson for physics concessions (HW-ID) and critical RPN failure modes, and Green for real-world 2026 test analogs and superlaser firing sequences.
Monospace Data First, Geometric Header Chrome: Squared-off Chakra Petch uppercase headers and section tags frame JetBrains Mono prose, equations, and tabular-nums budgets.
Zero-Radius Hardware Framing: Strict 0px corners across all web panels, buttons, pills, and scrubbers, anchored by 6px square status pips and right-aligned document section codes.

rules.name: The Semantic Signal Rule
rules.body: Never assign Amber (#e8a317), Cyan (#0891b2), Crimson (#dc2626), or Green (#16a34a) for arbitrary visual variety; each hue must correspond to its engineering meaning (Command/Inspection, Analysis/CDR, Concession/Danger, or Test-Eligible/Active Ignition).

rules.name: The Print Inversion Rule
rules.body: When rendering to print (@media print in print.css), all dark surfaces (#0a0a0e, #12141a, #1a1d26) invert deterministically to pure white (#ffffff) with black ink (#000000) and #333333/#555555 hairline borders so exported ledgers sit cleanly beside A4 engineering paperwork.

rules.name: The Tabular Exponent Rule
rules.body: All numerical readouts, RPN counters, and animated scrubbers must use JetBrains Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and proper Unicode superscripts (10¹⁸ kg, 10³² J, never 10^18 caret notation in display prose) so figures never jitter during count-up or scrubbing.

rules.name: The Uppercase Chrome Rule
rules.body: Chakra Petch is reserved for structural chrome—headers, kickers, tabs, buttons, and pills—almost always in uppercase with 0.08em to 0.3em positive tracking; never set multi-sentence paragraphs in Chakra Petch.

rules.name: The Zero-Shadow Chassis Rule
rules.body: Never apply box-shadow to a Panel, StatBlock, Pill, or button; hierarchy between containers is communicated by switching the 1px solid border from neutral #2d3340 to a semantic accent (#e8a317, #0891b2, #dc2626, #16a34a) and stepping surface luminance.

dos: Do stamp every Panel that represents a specification section or dataset with its corresponding document code (§0–§12, Appx A–H, HW-1 … HW-10, DR-01 … DR-16) in the right-aligned code slot (#5a5f6a, 10px).

Do use Pill components with semantic tones (red for Class C / HW-ID, cyan for Class A / DR-ID, amber for Class I / DS-1 FMEA, green for Class T / 2026 analogs) so verification status is scannable across both the web console and the Typst PDF.
Do pair Chakra Petch uppercase structural labels with JetBrains Mono tabular-nums values and explicit SI units (km, kg, W, J, MPa) on every metric and chart axis.
Do verify that any new table or ledger view degrades gracefully under @media print (print.css) into bordered black-on-white A4 portrait tables.
donts: Don't introduce border-radius (rounded-md, rounded-lg, rounded-full) on panels, buttons, pills, inputs, or tooltips in the web console; 0px corners are a load-bearing identity invariant.

Don't apply decorative drop shadows, glassmorphic cards, or multi-stop neon gradients to UI containers; reserve glow strictly for active physical states (StationDiagram core/beam and range slider thumbs).
Don't use Chakra Petch for body paragraphs, table cells, or mathematical equations; body copy and numeric data must always render in JetBrains Mono.
Don't mix or repurpose the four semantic signal colors (#e8a317, #0891b2, #dc2626, #16a34a) outside their assigned engineering verification and telemetry roles.
